items.label: Easy to Read Large Dial
items.value: Designed with clarity in mind, Case Width: 39.4 mm/1.15 in, the big, easy-to-read dial displays the time clearly, featuring both 12/24 hour military time formats for versatile use in various settings.

items.label: Night Light Feature
items.value: The built-in night light enables you to easily time-reading in low-light conditions, making it an ideal companion for the elderly or those with low vision. The light's battery type is CR2016.

items.label: Precise Second Hand Functionality
items.value: Equipped with a second hand, 12/24-hour format, and 60-minute scale, it ensures precision and ease of use, making it ideal for nighttime activities, outdoor adventures, or scenarios requiring continuous time tracking.

items.label: Water Resistant Design
items.value: 50M Water Resistant, suitable for everyday wear while washing vegetables, washing hands, and swimming, but not suitable for diving or adjusting the time underwater.

items.label: Thoughtful Gift Option
items.value: This classic and practical watch is a meaningful gift for Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas for boyfriends, girlfriends, husbands, wives, parents, and other loved ones.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Larg Easy to Read Dial, Light Up, Military Time, Second Hand, Waterproof

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Batteries (inside the watch) *2, Gift Box*1, Manual*1, Watch*1
